directives.text: Enforce a chart-level gate: if a support/resistance level has fewer than 2 touches, label it 'reference zone' or omit it from the caption.
Require every auto post to end with a '🎯 Verdict' line that separates long-term view from near-term action and cites a key level.
Replace certainty language in M&A and capex posts with conditional phrasing such as 'could support' or 'up to', and add execution or customer-concentration risk.
Round all prices, targets, and technical levels to at most 2 decimals; omit any figure not present in the source block.
Cap hidden_value and discovery captions at 1800 characters, state the thesis in the first sentence, and remove trailing ellipses.
Vary opening emoji and template across consecutive posts; avoid using the same category more than twice in a row and limit 🚀/🚨 to at most 3 per day.
